nebula.name: Nebula
nebula.description: Ionised gas clouds. Costs 2 movement. Battles here are fought in the nebula.

asteroid_belt.name: Asteroid Belt
asteroid_belt.description: Dense rock field. Costs 2 movement. Battles here are fought among the asteroids.

ion_storm.name: Ion Storm
ion_storm.description: A churning electrical storm. Costs 3 movement. Battles here are fought in the storm.

star.name: Star
star.description: The system's sun. Impassable: nothing flies through a star.

corona.name: Corona
corona.description: Searing plasma close to the sun. Costs 3 movement; battles here are fought in its glare.

jump_point.name: Jump Point
jump_point.description: dormant until Hyperdrive. Once it wakes, ships can leave the system.

void.name: Deep Void
void.description: Empty space between the hyperlanes. Impassable: ships travel along lanes.
